Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow

Interface NativeWindowMonitor

All Known Implementing Classes:
NativeBacksideWindow3D, NativeInputOnlyWindow3D, NativePopup3D, NativeWindow3D
public interface NativeWindowMonitor
Still work in progress. This provides only basic features at this moment This provides a level of abstraction between the the native window manager and the native window implementation.
